description: EE class trick / ability flags exposed in the same expert/ability UI as learned combat and exploration powers. These are not Four Against the Abyss expert skills.

flags.name: Stealth Training
flags.mechanic: Existing saved-game flag: applies the trained stealth-save bonus used by scout-ahead checks.

flags.name: Sacrifice Defense
flags.mechanic: Spend the ability to take a nearby ally's defense roll.

flags.name: Sacrifice Shield
flags.mechanic: Spend the ability to absorb a nearby ally's hit with your shield.

flags.name: Army of Dolls
flags.mechanic: Doll swarm attacks once per combat round.

flags.name: Divine Smite
flags.mechanic: Once per adventure: +3 Life damage against a major foe.
